title: Честный обзор Twitter Gravel V3 (wheeltop)

takeaways.text: Owner review (Russian, automatic captions) after about 650 km in three weeks of road commuting, including rain: no problems so far and nothing found at the first service; he describes quick acceleration, good rolling speed on the stock semi-slick tires and a stiff, efficient feel.
The hydraulic brakes stopped him confidently from 45 km/h; he likes the narrow stock bar and saddle, and the Wheeltop wireless groupset worked without glitches on a single charge so far.
The only noise was a single click when lifting the bike by the saddle; no creaks while riding.
He paid roughly RUB 86,000–87,000 for the bike in Russia (September 2026).

disclosure: The owner reviews his own 2025 Gravel V3 after 600+ km; the description mentions no sponsorship or supplied product.
summary: Russian-language owner review of a 2025 Gravel V3 in size 52 with Wheeltop GEX 1×13 wireless shifting, about 9.9 kg, after more than 600 km of commuting in all weather. The groupset differs from the catalog's 2×12 builds.
